'''Pál Gömöry''' (23 April 1936 &ndash; 7 May 2021) was a Hungarian [[sailing (sport)|sailor]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://adt.arcanum.com/en/view/Hajo_2003/?query=%22G%C3%B6m%C3%B6ry+P%C3%A1l%22&pg=204&layout=s|newspaper=[[Hajó (newspaper)|Hajó]]|language=Hungarian|title=Gömöry Pál|date=1 March 2003|page=67|via=[[Arcanum Newspapers]]|url-access=subscription}}</ref> He competed in the [[Sailing at the 1968 Summer Olympics – Flying Dutchman|Flying Dutchman event]] at the [[1968 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/62158 |title=Pál Gömöry |work=Olympedia |access-date=11 May 2021}}</ref>
